sections.title: Acknowledgment
sections.html: I acknowledge that I have received, read, and understand the Technology & Data Use policies contained in Chapter 07 of the Employee Handbook, Revision 4.0. I understand that company technology resources are for business use only, that I may not input confidential company or client data into unauthorized AI tools, and that I must report any cybersecurity incident immediately. I agree to comply with all technology policies during and after my employment.
